scope: Original 413 eligible market-direction pairs only. No side flips, new candidates, price threshold changes or deployment.

variants.veto_new_opposite: Veto if either newly closed 5m candle at T+5 or T+10 triggers an opposite DCA main signal. No new signal means retain.
variants.require_new_same: Latest fresh DCA event among T+5,T+10 must agree with original side; no new event means skip. There is no newly closed 15m candle before expiry.
variants.same_branch_closed: At T+10 main_5m must still meet routed band touch. For aux_short_15m recheck last CLOSED 15m band/pump state (unchanged since T).
variants.same_branch_partial15_proxy: Main_5m as above. For auxiliary short replace current 15m close by latest completed 1m close (available T+11), recompute BB20/2 from 19 completed 15m closes plus this partial close; retain original 4-bar pump comparison. Proxy, NOT an actual closed candle or exact 11:30 price.

notes: Hypotheses fixed before scoring this run. Previously explored history: neither period is a pristine holdout. Report winners sacrificed, losers removed, all variants and fee/slippage assumptions. Not a live readiness approval.
